exorcist_warrior.name: 퇴마 무사
exorcist_warrior.behavior: Approach on reachable terrain, stop and telegraph a single locked-direction swing. Avoid edges. No contact damage.

talisman_adept.name: 부적 도사
talisman_adept.behavior: Keep distance where terrain permits; fire one non-homing talisman at the aim position locked at release. Require line of sight and visible warning. No contact damage.

monk.name: 목탁 승려
monk.behavior: Slow approach and heavy close-range strike; no frontal immunity in first test.

bell_shaman.name: 방울 무당
bell_shaman.behavior: Stay behind allies and apply a small non-stacking shield after an interruptible chant; no summoning in first test.
